game_concept: A tower defense set in Mt. Pyre – Lava Tube Tunnel, a glowing lava tube: the volcanologist must handle lava imps while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Rounding Range: Use round() and abs() to snap messy measurements into valid slots.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Lava Tube Tunnel: a glowing lava tube
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
player_objective: Read score. Display Pass when score ≥ 56; otherwise display Retry. Check below, equal to and above the boundary. This is an exercise cutoff, not the adaptation rule. Test dataset 8: {'score': 55}; {'score': 57}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Rounding Range' (Week 2 slot 13), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Lava Tube Tunnel'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.

source_player_objective: Protect the summit beacon from lava imps in Lava Tube Tunnel: keep the slot_matches meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 34-second timer ends.
source_lose_condition: slot_matches drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 34-second timer ends.
source_game_title: Rounding Range – Lava Tube Tunnel Defense
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
